name: Ory
tagline: Open source identity infrastructure. OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, MFA, permissions.
shortDescription: Ory is an open source identity infrastructure. OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, WebAuthn, MFA, permissions API, and a control plane for managing identities. The CNCF identity stack.
longDescription:
## What it is

Ory is a suite of open source identity services: Ory Hydra (OAuth2/OIDC), Ory Kratos (identity/user management), Ory Oathkeeper (identity proxy), Ory Keto (permissions), and Ory Fosite (OAuth2 library). All CNCF projects, all production-grade.

## Why we recommend it

If you need OAuth2/OIDC/SAML/MFA and don't want to pay Auth0/Okta fees, Ory is the answer. Each component can be used standalone or composed. The license is Apache-2.0, and the cloud offering is reasonably priced.

## When to use it

- OAuth2/OIDC provider for your app
- Replacing Auth0/Okta with self-hosting
- Multi-tenant SaaS with per-tenant identity
- When you need SAML for enterprise SSO
installInstructions:
**Each component is a Go binary. Docker images are also available.**

**Ory Hydra (OAuth2/OIDC):**
```
docker run -d --name hydra -p 4444:4444 -p 4445:4445 oryd/hydra:latest serve all --dangerous-force-http
```

**Cloud:** Ory Network - free tier, $25/month production.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Ory Network: free tier. $25/month for production. Enterprise: custom.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Ory. Open source OAuth2/OIDC/SAML/MFA. CNCF identity stack. Self-hostable, Apache-2.0.

name: Authentik
tagline: Open source identity provider. OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, LDAP, MFA, with a great UI.
shortDescription: Authentik is an open source identity provider. OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, LDAP, SCIM, MFA, with a beautiful admin UI. The modern Keycloak alternative.
longDescription:
## What it is

Authentik is an open source identity provider. OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, LDAP, SCIM, MFA (TOTP, WebAuthn, SMS), admin UI, and a flexible policy engine. Python (Django) + Go, runs as a single container.

## Why we recommend it

If Keycloak feels heavy or has the UI you want to replace, Authentik is the modern alternative. The admin UI is clean, the policy engine is flexible, and the integrations cover most modern apps.

## When to use it

- SSO provider for a self-hosted stack
- OAuth2/OIDC/SAML for an enterprise
- MFA for hundreds of users
- Replacing Keycloak with a more modern UI
installInstructions:
**Docker Compose (recommended):**
```
git clone https://github.com/goauthentik/authentik
cd authentik
docker compose up -d
```
UI at http://localhost:9000.

**Cloud:** From $5/user/month (managed).
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Cloud: from $5/user/month. Free for personal use.

seo.metaTitle: Authentik - Modern Open Source Identity Provider
seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Authentik. Open source identity provider with OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, LDAP, MFA. Modern Keycloak alternative.

name: Authelia
tagline: Single Sign-On for self-hosted apps. Nginx/Traefik reverse proxy + 2FA.
shortDescription: Authelia is a Single Sign-On and 2FA proxy for self-hosted apps. Sits in front of your apps (Nginx, Traefik, Caddy), adds authentication and 2FA without modifying the apps.
longDescription:
## What it is

Authelia is a SSO and 2FA proxy for self-hosted apps. Sits between the user and your apps (Nginx, Traefik, Caddy, HAProxy), adds authentication (TOTP, WebAuthn, push, Yubikey) and authorization policies without modifying the apps themselves.

## Why we recommend it

If you have a homelab or small self-hosted stack (Grafana, Nextcloud, Portainer, etc.) and want SSO without setting up Keycloak, Authelia is the answer. Single Go binary, works with any reverse proxy.

## When to use it

- SSO for a homelab or small self-hosted stack
- 2FA for apps that don't support it natively
- Reverse-proxy-level auth (no app changes needed)
- When you want a lightweight alternative to Keycloak
installInstructions:
**Docker (standalone):**
```
docker run -d --name authelia -p 9091:9091 authelia/authelia
```

**Behind a reverse proxy:** Configure Nginx/Traefik/Caddy to forward auth requests to Authelia.

**Config:** configuration.yml (full example in the repo).
pricingDetails: Free. Apache-2.0 licensed. Single Go binary, low resource use.

seo.metaTitle: Authelia - SSO and 2FA for Self-Hosted Apps
seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Authelia. SSO and 2FA proxy for self-hosted apps. Works with Nginx, Traefik, Caddy.

name: Casdoor
tagline: Identity platform with a beautiful UI. OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, LDAP, MFA.
shortDescription: Casdoor is an open source identity platform with a beautiful modern UI. OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, LDAP, MFA, WebAuthn, multi-tenancy, role-based access, audit logs.
longDescription:
## What it is

Casdoor is an open source identity platform. OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, LDAP, MFA (TOTP, SMS, WebAuthn, Face ID), multi-tenancy, RBAC, audit logs, social login (Google, GitHub, etc.), and a beautiful admin UI.

## Why we recommend it

If you want a single-binary identity platform with a modern UI and the broadest set of features, Casdoor is the answer. The Go backend + React frontend are well-maintained.

## When to use it

- Identity platform for a SaaS
- Enterprise SSO with SAML
- Multi-tenant identity
- When you want a modern UI (not the Keycloak look)
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name casdoor -p 8000:8000 casdoor/casdoor
```

**Default login:** admin / 123 (change immediately).
pricingDetails: Free. Apache-2.0 licensed. Self-host on a small VPS.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Casdoor. Open source identity platform with OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, MFA, and a beautiful modern UI.

name: Logto
tagline: Open source Auth0 alternative. OIDC, OAuth2, MFA, multi-tenancy, modern UI.
shortDescription: Logto is an open source identity platform. OIDC, OAuth2, MFA (TOTP, WebAuthn, backup codes), social login, multi-tenancy, RBAC, beautiful UI, designed to be a drop-in Auth0 alternative.

Logto is an open source identity platform. OIDC, OAuth2, MFA, social login, multi-tenancy, RBAC, organizations, audit logs, account center UI, sign-in experience UI, and a beautiful admin console.

## Why we recommend it

If you want a modern Auth0 alternative that you can self-host, Logto is the answer. The pre-built sign-in/account UIs save weeks of work, and the multi-tenant support is first-class.

- Auth0 alternative with self-hosting
- B2B SaaS with multi-tenant identity

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Logto. Open source identity platform. OIDC, OAuth2, MFA, multi-tenancy, beautiful UI. Auth0 alternative.

name: SuperTokens
tagline: Open source auth with pre-built UI. Email/password, social, MFA, passwordless.
shortDescription: SuperTokens is an open source authentication solution with pre-built login/signup UIs. Email/password, social login, MFA, passwordless (email/SMS), session management, role-based access.
longDescription:
## What it is

SuperTokens is an open source authentication solution. Pre-built login/signup UI components (React, React Native, Vue, Angular), session management, email/password, social login, passwordless (email/SMS), MFA, and role-based access control.

## Why we recommend it

If you want a complete auth solution with pre-built UI but don't want to lock into Auth0, SuperTokens is the answer. The UI components are well-designed and customizable, and the backend is Apache-2.0.

## When to use it

- Apps that need login/signup UI without building it
- Auth0 alternative with self-hosting
- Email/password + social + MFA in one
- When you want pre-built session management
installInstructions:

```
docker run -d --name supertokens -p 3567:3567 registry.supertokens.io/supertokens/supertokens-core
```

**Managed (SuperTokens Cloud):** 5K MAU free. From $0.02/MAU after.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Cloud: 5K MAU free. $0.02/MAU after.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of SuperTokens. Open source auth with pre-built UI. Email/password, social, MFA, passwordless.

name: Zitadel
tagline: Identity platform built on Ory stack. OIDC, OAuth2, SAML, MFA, audit, B2B.
shortDescription: Zitadel is an identity platform built on top of the Ory stack. OIDC, OAuth2, SAML, MFA, audit logs, B2B multi-tenancy, organizations, role-based access. Modern Keycloak alternative.
longDescription:

Zitadel is an identity platform built on top of the Ory stack (Hydra, Kratos, Keto). Adds a user-friendly admin UI, multi-tenancy with organizations, audit logs, action triggers, and a hosted cloud option.

## Why we recommend it

If you want the Ory stack but with a UI and B2B multi-tenancy out of the box, Zitadel is the answer. The Swiss-made product is well-documented and the B2B SaaS features are excellent.

## When to use it

- B2B SaaS with per-customer identity
- Enterprise SSO with OIDC + SAML
- When you want Ory's power with a UI
- Replacing Keycloak for a multi-tenant SaaS
installInstructions:
**Docker Compose (recommended):**
```
git clone https://github.com/zitadel/zitadel
cd zitadel
docker compose up -d
```

**Cloud:** Zitadel Cloud - free tier (5K MAU), from $25/month.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Cloud: 5K MAU free. $25/month production.

seo.metaTitle: Zitadel - Identity Platform for B2B SaaS
seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Zitadel. Identity platform built on Ory. OIDC, OAuth2, SAML, MFA, B2B multi-tenancy. Modern Keycloak alternative.

name: OpenSearch
tagline: Open source Elasticsearch fork. Search, observability, analytics.
shortDescription: OpenSearch is the open source fork of Elasticsearch 7. Full-text search, log analytics (Observability), security analytics, vector search. Apache-2.0 licensed.
longDescription:
## What it is

OpenSearch is the open source fork of Elasticsearch 7, maintained by AWS and the Linux Foundation. Full-text search, log analytics (OpenSearch Dashboards), security analytics (SIEM), vector search (k-NN), and machine learning plugins.

## Why we recommend it

If you were on Elasticsearch and the license change to SSPL scared you, OpenSearch is the drop-in alternative. Same APIs (mostly), same scale, true open source.

## When to use it

- Elasticsearch alternative (after the license change)
- Full-text search for an app
- Log aggregation (with OpenSearch Dashboards)
- Vector search (k-NN plugin)
installCommand: docker run -d --name opensearch -p 9200:9200 -p 9600:9600 -e discovery.type=single-node -e DISABLE_SECURITY_PLUGIN=true opensearchproject/opensearch:latest
installInstructions:
**Docker (single-node):**
```
docker run -d --name opensearch -p 9200:9200 -e discovery.type=single-node -e DISABLE_SECURITY_PLUGIN=true opensearchproject/opensearch
```

**Docker Compose with OpenSearch Dashboards:** see opensearch.org docs.
pricingDetails: Free. Apache-2.0 licensed. AWS OpenSearch Service (managed) from $0.024/hour.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of OpenSearch. Open source fork of Elasticsearch 7. Full-text search, log analytics, vector search. Apache-2.0.

name: ZincSearch
tagline: Lightweight Elasticsearch alternative. Single Go binary, no JVM, low memory.
shortDescription: ZincSearch is a lightweight Elasticsearch alternative. Single Go binary, no JVM, low memory footprint, full-text search, log analytics, compatible with ES APIs.
longDescription:
## What it is

ZincSearch is a lightweight Elasticsearch alternative written in Go. Single binary, no JVM, low memory footprint (uses ~100MB vs GBs for ES), full-text search, log analytics, compatible with most ES APIs.

## Why we recommend it

If you want Elasticsearch-like search without the JVM overhead, Zinc is the answer. Perfect for small to medium deployments where ES is overkill.

## When to use it

- Elasticsearch alternative with low resource use
- Log aggregation on a small server
- Full-text search for a side project
- When you don't want to manage a JVM
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name zinc -p 4080:4080 public.ecr.aws/zinclabs/zincsearch
```

**Single binary:** Download from GitHub releases, ./zinc and you are done.
pricingDetails: Free. Apache-2.0 licensed. Single binary, low resource use.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of ZincSearch. Lightweight Elasticsearch alternative. Single Go binary, no JVM, low memory.

name: Sonic
tagline: Fast, lightweight search backend. Rust, ~30MB binary, auto-indexing.
shortDescription: Sonic is a fast, lightweight search backend written in Rust. Single ~30MB binary, auto-indexing, typo tolerance, geographic search, identifier search. Used in production by Opera.
longDescription:
## What it is

Sonic is a fast, lightweight search backend written in Rust. Single ~30MB binary, auto-indexing, typo tolerance (fuzzy search), geographic search, and identifier search. Used in production by Opera for browser search.

## Why we recommend it

If you need lightweight search (think: autocomplete for an app, search for a static site, etc.) without the complexity of Elasticsearch, Sonic is the answer. The single binary is small and fast.

## When to use it

- Autocomplete / typeahead search
- Search for a static site or app
- Low-resource search (small VPS)
- When Elasticsearch feels overkill
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name sonic -p 1491:1491 valeriansaliou/sonic
```

**Config:** /etc/sonic.cfg (see the repo for full example).

**Ingest:** sonic-ingest CLI tool.
pricingDetails: Free. MPL-2.0 licensed. Single ~30MB binary.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Sonic. Fast, lightweight search backend in Rust. Single ~30MB binary, typo tolerance, geo search.

name: Manticore Search
tagline: Fast, multi-threaded SQL search engine. Elasticsearch alternative, MySQL protocol.
shortDescription: Manticore Search is a fast, multi-threaded search engine. SQL-first (MySQL protocol), full-text search, vector search, faceted search, real-time indexing. The fastest ES alternative.
longDescription:
## What it is

Manticore Search is a fast, multi-threaded search engine forked from Sphinx. SQL-first (use MySQL client), full-text search, vector search (k-NN), faceted search, real-time indexing, JSON attributes, and geospatial search.

## Why we recommend it

If you want search that you can query with SQL (not a custom DSL), Manticore is the answer. The MySQL protocol means every MySQL client works, and the speed is impressive.

## When to use it

- Full-text search for a SQL-first team
- Real-time log analytics
- E-commerce product search
- Replacing Elasticsearch for SQL lovers
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name manticore -p 9306:9306 -p 9308:9308 manticoresearch/manticore
```

**Query with mysql client:**
```
mysql -h 0.0.0.0 -P 9306 -e "SELECT * FROM index WHERE MATCH('test')"
```
pricingDetails: Free. GPL-3.0 licensed. Self-host or use Manticore Cloud (from $19/month).

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Manticore Search. Fast, multi-threaded search engine. SQL-first via MySQL protocol. Elasticsearch alternative.

name: Apache Solr
tagline: Battle-tested open source search. The original Lucene-based search server.
shortDescription: Apache Solr is the original open source search server built on Apache Lucene. Battle-tested since 2004, full-text search, faceted search, geospatial, ML model upload, vector search (recent).
longDescription:
## What it is

Apache Solr is the original open source search server built on Apache Lucene. Battle-tested since 2004, used by Netflix, Apple, eBay, and many others. Full-text search, faceted search, geospatial, ML model upload, vector search (recent versions).

## Why we recommend it

If you need the most battle-tested open source search, Solr is it. The codebase has been around for 20 years and is incredibly mature. The performance is excellent at scale.

## When to use it

- Enterprise search with battle-tested stack
- E-commerce product search with faceting
- Search for large document collections
- When Elasticsearch is too heavy
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name solr -p 8983:8983 solr:solr
```

**Admin UI:** http://localhost:8983/solr
pricingDetails: Free. Apache-2.0 licensed. Self-host on JVM.

seo.metaTitle: Apache Solr - Battle-Tested Open Source Search
seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Apache Solr. The original open source search server on Lucene. Battle-tested since 2004.

name: Vespa
tagline: Open source big data serving engine. Search, recommendations, ML serving at scale.
shortDescription: Vespa is an open source big data serving engine. Combines search, recommendation, and ML model serving at scale. Used by Yahoo for serving search and recommendations.
longDescription:
## What it is

Vespa is an open source big data serving engine. Combines vector search, lexical search, ML model evaluation, and ranking in one engine. Built for serving billions of items with millisecond latency.

## Why we recommend it

If you need search + recommendations + ML serving in one engine (and at scale), Vespa is the answer. It is what Yahoo uses for its search and ads serving.

## When to use it

- Large-scale search (billions of items)
- Recommendation systems
- ML model serving with low latency
- When you need search + ranking + ML in one
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name vespa -p 8080:8080 -p 19071:19071 vespaengine/vespa
```

**Cloud:** Vespa Cloud (Yahoo) - from $0.05/hour.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Vespa Cloud: from $0.05/hour. Apache-2.0 licensed.

seo.metaTitle: Vespa - Open Source Big Data Serving Engine
seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Vespa. Open source engine for search, recommendations, and ML serving at scale. Used by Yahoo.

name: MinIO
tagline: S3-compatible object storage. Single binary, high-performance, S3 API.
shortDescription: MinIO is a high-performance, S3-compatible object storage. Single Go binary, scales from a single server to billions of objects, 100% S3 API compatible. The de facto S3 alternative.
longDescription:
## What it is

MinIO is a high-performance, S3-compatible object storage server. Single Go binary, scales from a single server to distributed clusters, 100% S3 API compatible, multi-tenant, with encryption, versioning, lifecycle, and replication.

## Why we recommend it

If you need S3-compatible storage that you can run yourself, MinIO is the answer. Drop-in replacement for AWS S3, runs on your own hardware or any cloud.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted S3 alternative
- Object storage for backups
- Data lake on premises
- S3-compatible dev environment (replaces aws s3 calls)
installCommand: docker run -d --name minio -p 9000:9000 -p 9001:9001 -v minio_data:/data -e MINIO_ROOT_USER=admin -e MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=admin123 minio/minio:latest server /data --console-address :9001
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name minio -p 9000:9000 -p 9001:9001 -v minio_data:/data -e MINIO_ROOT_USER=admin -e MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=admin123 minio/minio server /data --console-address :9001
```

**Console:** http://localhost:9001
pricingDetails: Free. AGPL-3.0 licensed. Self-host or use MinIO (the company) for support.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of MinIO. S3-compatible object storage. Single Go binary, high-performance, scales to billions of objects.

name: Seafile
tagline: Self-hosted file sync and share. Fast, reliable, with built-in encryption.
shortDescription: Seafile is a self-hosted file sync and share platform. Fast, reliable, with built-in encryption, libraries, teams, sharing links, and integrations with Office/OnlyOffice.
longDescription:
## What it is

Seafile is a self-hosted file sync and share platform. Python + C, fast (uses a custom protocol for sync), libraries, teams, sharing links, web upload, mobile apps, desktop clients, and integrations with Collabora/OnlyOffice for online editing.

## Why we recommend it

If you want a self-hosted Dropbox/Google Drive alternative that's faster than Nextcloud sync, Seafile is the answer. The custom protocol is much faster than WebDAV for large libraries.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted Dropbox/Drive alternative
- File sync for a team or organization
- When you need fast sync (many files, large files)
- Online document editing (with OnlyOffice/Collabora)
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name seafile -p 80:80 seafileltd/seafile
```

**Manual:** See docs.seafile.com for the manual install on Linux.
pricingDetails: Community Edition: free. Pro Edition: from $800/year per 100 users.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Seafile. Self-hosted file sync and share. Fast, reliable, with built-in encryption. The faster Nextcloud alternative.

name: ownCloud
tagline: Self-hosted file sync and share. WebDAV, federation, mature.
shortDescription: ownCloud is a self-hosted file sync and share platform. WebDAV-based, federation, mature, with online editing (via Collabora), file drop, password-protected links, and enterprise features.
longDescription:
## What it is

ownCloud is a self-hosted file sync and share platform. PHP + Go, WebDAV-based, federation (ownCloud Global Scale), online editing (Collabora), file versioning, password-protected links, end-to-end encryption, and enterprise features.

## Why we recommend it

If you want a mature, federated self-hosted file sync platform, ownCloud is the answer. The codebase has been around since 2010 and the enterprise features are well-developed.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted Dropbox/Drive alternative
- File sync for an enterprise
- Federated file sync (multiple servers)
- Compliance-heavy deployments (with E2E encryption)
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name owncloud -p 80:80 owncloud/server
```

**Manual:** LAMP stack + download from owncloud.com.
pricingDetails: Community: free. Enterprise: from $3,600/year per 100 users.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of ownCloud. Self-hosted file sync and share. WebDAV, federation, mature. Enterprise features.

name: FileRun
tagline: Self-hosted file management. Beautiful UI, WebDAV, mobile, file preview.
shortDescription: FileRun is a self-hosted file management and sync platform. Beautiful UI, WebDAV, mobile apps, file preview (PDF, images, video, Office), share links, and tight Nextcloud compatibility.
longDescription:
## What it is

FileRun is a self-hosted file management and sync platform. PHP + MySQL, beautiful UI (Google Drive-like), WebDAV, mobile apps (iOS, Android), file preview (PDF, images, video, Office via Collabora/OnlyOffice), and share links with passwords/expiry.

## Why we recommend it

If you want a Google Drive-like UI for your self-hosted files, FileRun is the answer. The UI is more modern than Nextcloud's, and the file preview is excellent.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted Google Drive alternative with modern UI
- File management for small teams
- When you want a Dropbox-like experience
- WebDAV server with mobile access
installCommand: Download from filerun.com and follow the install guide
installInstructions:
**Requirements:** LAMP/LEMP, PHP 7.4+, MySQL/MariaDB.

**Install:**
1. Download FileRun from filerun.com
2. Unzip into a web-served directory
3. Visit http://your-server/ and follow the installer

**License:** Free for personal use. From $49/year per user for commercial.
pricingDetails: Personal: free. Commercial: $49/year per user. Enterprise: custom.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of FileRun. Self-hosted file management with Google Drive-like UI, WebDAV, mobile apps, file preview.

name: Pydio Cells
tagline: Self-hosted file sharing and sync. Go-based, modern UI, enterprise features.
shortDescription: Pydio Cells is a self-hosted file sharing and sync platform. Go-based, modern UI, enterprise features (LDAP, audit, share policies), tight Nextcloud/ownCloud migration path.
longDescription:
## What it is

Pydio Cells is a self-hosted file sharing and sync platform. Go-based, modern UI, enterprise features (LDAP, audit logs, share policies, encryption), and good migration tools from Nextcloud/ownCloud.

## Why we recommend it

If you need a self-hosted file sync with enterprise features and a Go backend (lower resource use than PHP alternatives), Pydio is the answer.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted Dropbox/Drive for an enterprise
- Migration from Nextcloud or ownCloud
- Go-based, low-resource deployment
- When you need audit logs + share policies
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name pydio -p 8080:8080 -v pydio_data:/data pydio/cells
```

**Binary:** Download from pydio.com, run ./cells configure and follow the wizard.
pricingDetails: Community: free. Enterprise: from $5/user/month with support.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Pydio Cells. Go-based self-hosted file sharing and sync. Modern UI, enterprise features.

name: Syncthing
tagline: Peer-to-peer continuous file sync. No cloud, no accounts, fully private.
shortDescription: Syncthing is a peer-to-peer continuous file synchronization program. No cloud, no accounts, no central server - devices sync directly. End-to-end encrypted, cross-platform.
longDescription:
## What it is

Syncthing is a peer-to-peer continuous file synchronization program. No cloud, no accounts, no central server - devices sync directly with each other. End-to-end encrypted (TLS), cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows, BSD, Android, iOS via partners).

## Why we recommend it

If you want to sync files between your own devices without a third-party cloud, Syncthing is the answer. The P2P design means no server costs, no privacy concerns, no data limits.

## When to use it

- Sync between your own devices (laptop, phone, NAS)
- Privacy-sensitive file sync (no cloud)
- Replacing Dropbox/Resilio for personal use
- Server-to-server sync (without a central node)
installCommand: apt install syncthing  # or: brew install syncthing
installInstructions:
**Linux:**
```
apt install syncthing  # Debian/Ubuntu
brew install syncthing  # macOS
```

**Web UI:** http://localhost:8384 (default).

**Mobile:** Syncthing-Fork (Android), Mobius Sync (iOS).
pricingDetails: Free. MPL-2.0 licensed. No server, no accounts, no fees.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Syncthing. Peer-to-peer continuous file sync. No cloud, no accounts, fully private.

name: Garage
tagline: S3-compatible distributed object storage. Rust, lightweight, for small clusters.
shortDescription: Garage is an S3-compatible distributed object storage written in Rust. Designed for small clusters (3-10 nodes), low resource use, geo-distribution, and S3 API compatibility.
longDescription:
## What it is

Garage is a S3-compatible distributed object storage written in Rust. Designed for small clusters (3-10 nodes) where MinIO or Ceph feel heavy. Low resource use, geo-distribution, automatic data placement, and full S3 API.

## Why we recommend it

If you need a distributed S3 alternative for a small cluster (homelab, edge deployment, small org) and want a Rust-based low-resource option, Garage is the answer. Built by Deuxfleurs, a French non-profit.

## When to use it

- Distributed S3 storage for small clusters
- Edge deployments (multiple sites, one bucket)
- Low-resource S3 alternative
- Homelab distributed storage
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name garage -p 3900:3900 -p 3901:3901 -p 3902:3902 dxflrs/garage
```
